parameters.query:
INSERT INTO report_raw_ghl_calls (call_id, contact_id, assigned_user_id, location_id, direction, status, duration_ms, started_at, ended_at, answered_at, recording_url, notes, payload_json, batch_id, loaded_at)
SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::timestamptz, $9::timestamptz, $10::timestamptz, $11, $12, $13::jsonb, $14, $15::timestamptz
ON CONFLICT (call_id) DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  duration_ms = EXCLUDED.duration_ms,
  ended_at = EXCLUDED.ended_at,
  answered_at = EXCLUDED.answered_at,
  recording_url = EXCLUDED.recording_url,
  notes = EXCLUDED.notes,
  payload_json = EXCLUDED.payload_json,
  loaded_at = NOW()

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { ok: true, workflow: 'LT - GHL Daily Calls Ingest', status: 'completed' } }];
